keyEvents.text: Goal! Atlético Mineiro 0, Flamengo 1. Everton (Flamengo) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Gonzalo Plata with a through ball.
Lyanco (Atlético Mineiro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Atlético Mineiro 0, Flamengo 1.
Substitution, Atlético Mineiro. Renzo Saravia replaces Natanael.
Pedro (Flamengo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Flamengo. Samuel Lino replaces Everton.
Substitution, Atlético Mineiro. Igor Gomes replaces Gabriel Menino.
Tomás Cuello (Atlético Mineiro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Flamengo. Giorgian de Arrascaeta replaces Pedro.
Substitution, Flamengo. Saúl Ñíguez replaces Gonzalo Plata.
Substitution, Atlético Mineiro. Biel replaces Rony.
Substitution, Atlético Mineiro. Dudu replaces Guilherme Arana.
Substitution, Atlético Mineiro. Alexsander replaces Tomás Cuello.
Second Half ends, Atlético Mineiro 0, Flamengo 1.
Penalty Shootout begins Atlético Mineiro 0, Flamengo 1.
